text: I speak up when I notice a mistake, even when it would be easier to leave it unmentioned.
I give colleagues accurate information, including when the facts are inconvenient.
I keep commitments I have made, or communicate early when I cannot meet them.
I handle confidential information with care, even when no one is checking.
I take responsibility for the impact of my decisions on others.
I am comfortable asking for clarification when a request feels inconsistent with our standards.
I acknowledge other people’s contributions when sharing the results of a team effort.
I make decisions I can explain openly to the people affected by them.
I look for practical ways to improve the quality of my work.
I check important details before I consider a task finished.
I seek feedback that can help me strengthen my skills.
I adjust my approach when the first solution does not work well.
I set clear priorities when several tasks need my attention.
I share useful learning so the team can benefit from it.
I balance high standards with the time and resources available.
I follow through on improvements after identifying an issue.
People can rely on me to provide a clear update when work is delayed.
I verify important information before I pass it on to others.
I remain steady and respectful when someone raises a concern.
I explain what I can and cannot promise before setting expectations.
I keep relevant people informed when a decision affects their work.
I follow agreed processes when accuracy or safety depends on them.
I make space for questions when explaining a change or decision.
I stay composed while working through an unexpected challenge.
I protect the trust people place in me and in the organization.
I raise concerns through appropriate channels rather than letting them grow unnoticed.
I support team decisions once concerns have been heard and resolved.
I represent my team respectfully when working with people outside it.
I contribute to shared goals, even when the work is outside my usual routine.
I handle disagreements directly and constructively with the people involved.
I take care not to share internal information beyond those who need it.
I stay engaged with the team through periods of change.
I invite perspectives from colleagues whose experiences differ from mine.
I offer help when I see a teammate facing a demanding workload.
I listen fully before responding to a different point of view.
I share context that helps others contribute effectively.
I recognize the value of work that happens behind the scenes.
I adapt how I communicate to help different colleagues work together.
I work toward solutions that consider the needs of the wider team.
I make an effort to include quieter voices in group discussions.
I celebrate team progress as well as individual achievements.
I treat colleagues with respect, including when we disagree.
I contribute to a workplace where people can ask for help without embarrassment.
I address unhelpful behavior calmly and through appropriate channels.
I respect reasonable boundaries around other people’s time and availability.
I notice when work pressure may be affecting the team and raise it constructively.
I make room for different working styles while keeping shared commitments.
I give feedback in a way that is specific and considerate.
I help keep team discussions focused on ideas rather than personal criticism.
I take breaks and encourage sustainable habits during demanding periods.
